# collage-poster-build — Paper Pile → Headline Lands → One Highlighter Swipe

**intent**: The collage opener. A paper board fills with small cut-outs (tags, labels, scraps) that pile up on twos; the hero headline, torn from a magazine, slaps on top of the pile exactly when it is read; one highlighter swipe marks the verdict word; tape pins it; the camera has been pushing in slowly the whole time. Built on `collage-kit`.

**roles served**

- Hook: the problem in one line over the evidence ("Your team has AI tools. / Nobody changed how they work." over a pile of AI-tool tags).
- Problem: a claim over a pile of its symptoms (open tabs, sticky notes, unread reports as paper scraps).
- Product_Intro: the name of the thing landing over the pile of what it replaces.

**duration**: 4.5–6.5 s.

**shot structure**

```
Scene 1 (0.0–~1.0s): paper ground (grid optional), slow push-in starts. [N = 3–6 small pieces]
  — tags / labels / scraps carrying [the evidence words] — slap in as a pile, staggered 0.1–0.15 s,
  alternating sides, resting tilts ±4–12°, in the back layer around the frame edges.
Scene 2 (~0.9–~2.6s): [headline strip 1] (torn top/bottom, display face) slaps on top of the pile,
  centred upper-third; a tape strip pins its corner. [headline strip 2] (serif second voice or
  a contrasting strip) slaps under it ~1.2 s later, when it is read.
Scene 3 (~2.6–~3.5s): the highlighter swipes behind [the verdict word] in strip 2 (one word).
Scene 4 (~3.5s–end): held read. Everything boils on twos; the push continues; nothing new arrives.
```

**signature move**: the hero headline lands **on top of** a pile that is already there — the evidence first, the claim on top — then exactly one highlighter swipe.

**motion vocabulary**: slap on twos (pile + hero), tape, highlighter swipe, boil, smooth push-in with two-layer parallax.

**rule mapping**

- pile + hero slap → `rules/collage-cutout-slap.md`
- torn headline strips → `rules/collage-paper-tear.md`
- highlighter + tape → `rules/collage-marker-annotate.md`
- boil, on twos → `rules/collage-stop-motion-boil.md`
- push-in + parallax → `rules/collage-camera.md`
- scaffold + helpers → `rules/collage-kit.md`

**layout (4:5 / 9:16)**: hero strips stacked in the band y ≈ 25–65% of the frame, ~85% of the width; pile pieces hug the corners and edges, partly under the strips; nothing important in the bottom 17%.

**stillness note**: Scene 4 is a held read (≥ 1.5 s on a silent video). Do not add drifting or extra pieces after the highlighter.
